comparison: cover crop vs. no cover crop control
metric: grain corn yield response ratio (yield with CC / yield without CC)
uncertainty: bootstrapped 95% CI overlapped 1 (not significant); CI values shown only in Figure S2
quote: Among the field crops, grain corn (RR = 1.03, n = 326), soybean (RR = 1.06, n = 109), and winter wheat (RR = 1.01, n = 23) showed greater, yet non-significant, crop yields with CCs than the no-CC control (Figure S2).
note: RR 1.03 = +3% grain corn yield, non-significant. Unweighted meta-analysis of ln(RR).

comparison: cover crop vs. no cover crop control

quote: For instance, a meta-analysis by Alvarez et al. [17] reported that corn (Zea mays L.) grain yield decreased by 8% following the use of non-leguminous CC species, whereas soybean (Glycine max L.) yield was not impacted by CCs.
